title: exports title top-align fix
description:
ScreenHeader's Row centered its children vertically. Exports is the
only caller passing actions (the Clear TextButton), and an m3 1.3.0
TextButton occupies a 48dp minimum touch-target height, so when jobs
exist the Row grew 32dp -> 48dp and the centered 32dp headlineSmall
title dropped ~8dp below Library/Projects/Settings, which never render
actions.

Change the Row's verticalAlignment from CenterVertically to Top: the
title pins to Row top + 0 in both cases, so its absolute y is
identical with or without the actions slot, and the no-actions screens
are unchanged (the title was and remains the Row's tallest child).
No conditional padding: any offset would reintroduce the shift it
exists to prevent. Clear keeps its 48dp target (DESIGN.md floor) and
all paddings are untouched.
changed: fix: exports title top-aligns invariant to actions
